messages.subject: Meeting this Wednesday
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies,

Welcome back from Spring Break! We are meeting at our normal time this Wednesday (4/3): 10am-noon in the Datalab classroom (360 Shields library). This meeting is to help folks who come in with R programming questions, so come join us and we'll figure out how to help you. This is a hybrid meeting so you can also join us via Zoom at this link: https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09 

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
